body.intent: Cut rhiza ship open-pr's peak memory: earlyoom SIGTERMed 'rhiza ship open-pr' twice on 2026-11-17 at VmRSS 2.2 GB. Its pre-push check runs rhiza check in-process over a fresh checkout (internal/api/ship_prepush.go prePushRhizaCheck), and rhiza check alone on this repo (7,298 log entries) peaks at 832 MB RSS. Profile open-pr's check/fold path on a repo this size and cut the dominant allocations, with a memory budget that catches a regression. Found while planning the throwaway projections leak fix (01M7PZQ4).
